driver_is_policyholder.quote: damage to my Nexon (TN10BX3391). On 3rd April 2026 evening, I was waiting in traffic at the ECR signal near Thiruvanmiyur when a small delivery van in front reversed suddenly and hit the front... sorry, the REAR of my car

facts.incident_summary: The policyholder was waiting in traffic when a delivery van suddenly reversed into the rear of her car, causing damage to the bumper, boot door, and tail light. Due to a work trip to Singapore, she experienced a delay in submitting the claim and bringing the car to the garage.
